messages:
Alex: FYI seeing steady memory growth on canary2 during a long streaming-chat + tool-loop run. KV resident climbs from ~4GB to ~12GB over ~45m, never goes down. link: https://internal/trace/abc123 :thinking:
Marisol: can you paste heap/profile output? also which image/kernel selection was used on that canary?
Alex: kernel: aten-opt-v3, batcher: continuous-default. here's a quick heap summary (pprof top):
```
(pprof) top10
  7.8GB  35.6%  runtime.mallocgc
  3.9GB  17.8%  cmd/kvcache.(*Shard).Insert
  2.1GB   9.6%  cmd/kvcache.(*Shard).Get (hot path)
  1.2GB   5.5%  slab.alloc
  0.9GB   4.1%  io.copy
```
```
Alex: note lots of small objects in slab.alloc on flamegraphs too. growth correlates with long context length + repeated tool invocations in the same session.
Jamie: sounds like fragmentation + reuse failure. tool loop might be pinning slices/refs so the KV entries can't be evicted/repurposed. do we have KV reference counts?
Alex: KV refs are refcounted but I suspect reuse path fails when streaming + tool loop because we attach tool metadata -> context pointer that prevents reuse.
Ryan: quick hypothesis: two separate bugs: eviction thresholds are too permissive for this access pattern, and reuse code does not clear metadata pointers on heavy streaming. try bumping REDWOOD_KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD down (0.6 -> 0.4) and enable COMPACT pass.
Tara: can we reproduce with a deterministic load? if so we can run bisection on commit range.
Alex: repro script (synthetic):
```
for i in {1..500}; do 
  curl -sS -X POST https://canary2/api/v1/stream \
    -d '{"session_id":"s$RANDOM","messages":["token stream.."],"tool_loop":true}' &
  sleep 0.2
done
```
Alex: ran that for 1h, memory still climbs. attached pprof and heap dump to the issue.
Marisol: good. next steps: 1) run pprof with `GOMEMLIMIT` set to low value to force GC cycle and see if memory is reclaimed, 2) run with KV_DEBUG=1 to log evictions, 3) capture allocation traces with `pprof -alloc_space` for a short window.
Jamie: also check kernel selection fallback: aten-opt-v3 has a slightly different memory allocation pattern for KV packing. try running the same workload with aten-opt-v2 to see if kernel path affects fragmentation.
Ryan: I pushed a small change to kv/reuse to clear tool metadata earlier in the path (branch: fix/kv-clear-meta). can someone run a canary with that branch?
Tara: I'll queue a canary build now and enable REDWOOD_KV_COMPACT_INTERVAL=2m on the test cluster. will report back in ~30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: canary build queued: fix/kv-clear-meta -> canary2 (build id b-2026-2143)
sre-bot: alert created: ENG-RUNTIME-1815 mem-growth-canary2 (sev3)
Marisol: if compacting helps we still need to address underlying reuse bug — compaction is mitigation. also add unit test that simulates tool-loop refs and ensures reuse path returns blocks to free list.
Alex: FYI enabling KV_DEBUG showed many entries where eviction was skipped because `pinned==true` on the shard. looks like we accumulate pinned entries across loop iterations.
Jamie: pinned counts should drop when session ends. maybe streaming keeps sessions open but shouldn't pin entries forever. check session lifecycle code in streaming manager.
Ryan: added logging patch to streaming manager to emit session-close events. PR: https://internal/pull/5421
Tara: canary currently at +30m after deploy: memory growth rate reduced from 150MB/10m -> 20MB/10m. compaction + clear-meta seems to help.
Alex: nice. still seeing small steady growth though — could be fragmentation left by many small allocs. next: run jemalloc background arena update or enable slab defragmentation.
Marisol: add test that runs for ~2h with synthetic tool-loop and compares arena fragmentation counters. if we see fragmentation that matches pprof, escalate to runtime infra for allocator tuning.
Ryan: plan: 1) merge kv clear-meta after tests, 2) add eviction telemetry to console, 3) create regression test in perf harness for long-context streaming tool-loop.
Alex: sounds good. I'll update the issue with the reduced canary graphs and attach the compaction run logs. thanks all :thumbsup:
Tara: closing loop in a few hours unless growth returns. ping if you want me to keep extended run.
Marisol: great work everyone. keep an eye on kernel-v3 vs v2 differences, we should document in ops playbook which kernel is recommended for long streaming sessions.
Alex: +1.
Marisol: marking follow-ups: ACTION-1 reproduce with aten-opt-v2, ACTION-2 add unit test for reuse clearing metadata, ACTION-3 perf regression test in harness.
Alex: noted. keeping the heap dumps at https://internal/artifacts/heap-dumps/1815001234.tar.gz
Tara: leaving extended run on for now. :white_check_mark:
